items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a point of a quasi-separated algebraic space the conditions of having codimension zero, of having zero dimensional local ring and of being a generic point of an irreducible component are equivalent, and that such a point has an open neighbourhood which is a scheme (statement lines 1597-1608). The proof (proof lines 1610-1653) identifies the first two conditions by definition, gives an elementary proof of the equivalence with the third through a filtration by open subspaces with bijective scheme charts, and quotes the proposition on open dense subschemes for the final assertion. H2: an equivalence with an explicit elementary argument, written out in full.
